panels.title: Needs Anton
panels.description: needs-anton labels, a stalled handoff, an agent failing 3 times in a row or late, a collision, ≥ 5 denials in 1 h or ≥ 3 backoffs on one agent, a PR waiting > 60 min. Amber when the pause is the only reason. — when local data is stale.

targets.expr: (((((sum(epic_needs_operator and on() (time() - epic_github_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300))) or vector(0)) + ((sum(epic_handoff_stalled)) or vector(0)) + ((count(epic_tick_consecutive_failures >= 3)) or vector(0)) + ((count(epic_agent_presence == 4)) or vector(0)) + ((count(count by (target) (epic_agent_collision) > 1)) or vector(0)) + ((count((sum by (agent) (increase(epic_permission_decisions_total{decision="deny"}[1h])) and on(agent) epic_agent_info) >= 5)) or vector(0)) + ((count(count by (agent) (epic_backoff_info) >= 3)) or vector(0)) + ((count(epic_handoff_wait_seconds > 3600)) or vector(0))) > 0) or (-1 * sum(epic_pause_requested == 1)) or vector(0)) and on() (time() - epic_local_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 30)
((count(count by (target) (epic_agent_collision) > 1)) or vector(0)) and on() (time() - epic_local_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 30)

panels.title: Agents
panels.description: One row per registered agent, running first. Last 20: outcome counts of the last 20 ticks, colored by the worst. Backoff: Codex retry delays. Denied: Claude permission gate.

targets.expr: (epic_agent_presence_info and on() (time() - epic_local_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 30)) or on(agent) label_replace(max by (agent) (epic_agent_info), "presence", "data stale", "", "")

(epic_agent_row_info and on() (time() - epic_local_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 30)) * on(target) group_left(task, task_url) (epic_task_context_info and on() (time() - epic_github_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300)) or on(agent) (epic_agent_row_info and on() (time() - epic_local_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 30)) or on(agent) label_replace(max by (agent) (epic_agent_info), "outcome_text", "data stale", "", "")
round(sum by (agent) (increase(epic_permission_decisions_total{decision="deny"}[1h]))) and on(agent) epic_agent_info and on() (time() - epic_local_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 30)

panels.title: Handoff · per kind
panels.description: Ready PRs of each kind waiting for a review by the other kind. Amber: a wait over 15 min, or no agent of the reviewer kind. Red: over 30 min.

targets.expr: label_replace(epic_agents_registered_kind{kind="codex"} and on() (time() - epic_local_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 30), "waiter_kind", "claude", "", "") or label_replace(epic_agents_registered_kind{kind="claude"} and on() (time() - epic_local_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 30), "waiter_kind", "codex", "", "")

panels.title: Epic progress
panels.description: Checklist leaves per area: done by Claude, done by Codex, still open.

targets.expr: sum by (area, kind) (epic_area_leaves{state="done"}) and on() (time() - epic_github_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300)

panels.title: Open PRs
panels.description: Review is the other kind's latest verdict for the current head. This page never authorizes a merge.
